meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 盯住一个 PR 直到可合并:反复查看合并状态、CI 结果、新评论和未解决的 review 线程;把真实问题修成独立提交并跑相关测试/构建后推送,核实后才解决线程;直至检查通过且没有待办意见或未解决线程才停止。
howto.when: 用户要求 babysit、monitor,或要求持续盯 PR 评论、review 和 CI 直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 PR babysit 到能合并
say.note: 它会进入循环值守,直到条件满足

say.text: 盯着 #42 的 review 和 CI,有问题就修
say.note: 按 30–60 秒间隔轮询,并处理新评论

say.text: monitor 这个 PR,直到所有检查通过
say.note: 检查完成后会汇报最新状态和证据

howto.what_en: Repeatedly checks PR merge state, CI, comments and open review threads; fixes confirmed issues and pushes; resolves threads only after verifying the fix; stops once checks pass with no actionable comments or unresolved threads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to babysit or monitor a PR, or to keep watching PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until it merges.
Keep watching #42's reviews and CI; fix what comes up.
Monitor this PR until all checks pass.
